title: Block Matching
text: 估计图像或视频帧之间的运动，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；{Estimate motion between} 指定估计图像或帧之间的运动 Current frame and N-th frame、{N} 指定帧数、{Search method} 指定块匹配搜索方法、{Block matching criteria} 指定块匹配准则 Mean square error、{Block size [height width]} 指定块大小、{Overlap size [r c]} 指定块重叠、{Maximum displacement [r c]} 指定最大位移、{Velocity output} 指定速度输出 Magnitude-squared，按实例取值。

ports.name: I/I1
ports.summary: 图像或视频帧 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: I2
ports.summary: 图像或视频帧 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: |V|^2
ports.summary: 速度幅值 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: V
ports.summary: 复数形式的速度分量 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Estimate motion between
params.values: 估计图像或帧之间的运动 Current frame and N-th frame back (default) | Two images

params.name: Search method
params.values: 块匹配搜索方法 Exhaustive (default) | Three-step

params.name: Block matching criteria
params.values: 块匹配准则 Mean square error (MSE) (default) | Mean absolute difference (MAD)

params.name: Velocity output
params.values: 速度输出 Magnitude-squared (default) | Horizontal and vertical components in complex form
